title: Russian — international telegrams (iuliia 'telegram')
description: Simplified scheme of the instruction for international telegrams, used for very compact Latin output: Ж→J, Й→I, Х→H, Ц→C, Щ→SC, Ю→IU, Я→IA, Ъ and Ь omitted; no context rules.
notes: Table as published by iuliia; the instruction itself is a telecom document, not a name-romanization standard.
samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
Iuliia, sesh esce etih miagkih francuzskih bulok iz Ioshkar-Oly, da vypei altaiskogo chaiu
